name: Globe
description: Dots squashed into ellipses toward the rim of a great sphere in the middle of the sheet, with small dots scattered round it.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: @calc(round((((sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (min(@X, @Y) / 2)) < 1) * 84 + (1 - ((sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (min(@X, @Y) / 2)) < 1)) * 22) * 100) / 100)%; height: @calc(round((((sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (min(@X, @Y) / 2)) < 1) * 84 + (1 - ((sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (min(@X, @Y) / 2)) < 1)) * 22) * 100) / 100)%; margin: @calc(round((0 - @calc(round((((sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (min(@X, @Y) / 2)) < 1) * 84 + (1 - ((sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (min(@X, @Y) / 2)) < 1)) * 22) * 100) / 100) / 2) * 100) / 100)% 0 0 @calc(round((0 - @calc(round((((sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (min(@X, @Y) / 2)) < 1) * 84 + (1 - ((sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (min(@X, @Y) / 2)) < 1)) * 22) * 100) / 100) / 2) * 100) / 100)%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); transform: rotate(@calc(round((atan2(@dy, @dx) * 180 / PI) * 100) / 100)deg) scaleX(@calc(round((sqrt(max(0.08, 1 - min(1, (sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (min(@X, @Y) / 2))) * min(1, (sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (min(@X, @Y) / 2)))))) * 100) / 100)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
